weekly_objective: Restart cleanly after three missed days, using today's threshold session as the week's one quality stimulus, and protect aerobic volume and the second strength session around the wet weekend.
coach_says: You missed Monday to Wednesday, including Tuesday's group ride, but your recovery numbers look good: HRV is balanced, resting HR is normal and form is +13%. So I'm not cramming the lost intensity back in. Today's threshold session and gym are your one quality day, and Friday's trail ride grows to 2 hours because it's the only dry day. The heavy drizzle on Saturday moves the long ride onto the trainer at 2 hours, with Workout B in the afternoon. If illness or exhaustion caused the missed days, ride today's fallback, keep Friday at 90 min and tell me.

days.details:
Warmup: 200 m easy (100 free / 50 back / 50 choice)
Main set: 4x50 m drill/swim by 25 (catch-up, fingertip drag) @ easy, 15s rest; 4x100 m pull buoy @ RPE 4, smooth bilateral breathing, 20s rest
Cooldown: 200 m easy mixed strokes
Total: 1000 m
Objective: Loosen up and add aerobic volume without leg load before Tuesday's double.

days.session: Committed double: AM controlled hills + PM hard MTB group ride
days.details:
AM (before work):
60 min | Climbing strength, save legs for PM | Z2 with climbs at Z3, RPE 5-6
15 min Z2 warm-up
4x5 min seated climbing at Z3, low cadence 65-75 rpm, RPE 6, with ~4 min easy descent/spin between
10 min Z1-2 cool-down
Wet roads: take descents cautiously; if the drizzle turns heavy, do the same efforts on the trainer.
Between: eat a carb-rich lunch and snack mid-afternoon.

PM (after work):
~90 min | Committed hard MTB group ride | Ride as the group dictates
Trails will be greasy, so choose lines over speed.
Fuel 40-60 g carbs/h and bring a bottle with electrolytes.
days.fallback: If RHR is 5+ bpm above average with low HRV or poor sleep: replace the AM hills with a 40 min Z1-2 spin (or skip it). Still do the PM group ride, but sit in, skip the attacks and let gaps go on climbs.

days.details:
45 min | Recovery from Tuesday | Z1-2, RPE 2-3
Flat road route, cadence 90+ rpm, no efforts, avoid hills.
Overcast and dry. Before or after work, whichever suits. Swap for 45 min yoga if legs are very heavy.

AM (before work, outdoors, clear):
50 min | Threshold | Z4, ~95-100% FTP, RPE 7-8
12 min Z2 warm-up incl. 2x1 min high-cadence spin-ups
3x8 min Z4 with 3 min Z1 recovery
8 min Z1-2 cool-down
Use a flat road or a steady drag with no junctions.

Lunch:
Workout A:
Warm-up: 5 min row, bodyweight squats, hip hinges, glute bridges, 2 ramp-up sets on squat
Back Squat 3x6 (3 RIR, controlled descent)
Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (3 RIR)
Pull-up 3x6 (assisted if needed)
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x8 (2 RIR)
Pallof Press 3x10/side
Side Plank 3x30s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between squat and RDL sets, 60-90 s for the rest
Objective: Restart heavy lower-body strength for pedalling force on a hard day, so easy days stay easy.
days.fallback: If signals are poor: ride the full 50 min in Z2 with no intervals. Do Workout A with 2 sets per lift at 4 RIR, or skip it.

days.details:
120 min | Aerobic endurance on trails, recover lost volume on the only dry day | Z2, RPE 3-4
Steady flowing trails. Spin or walk the steep pitches rather than surging, and keep HR in Z2. Legs may feel Thursday's squats in the first 20 min, so start very easy.
Overcast and dry, breezy (up to 23 km/h), so wooded trails are a good choice.
Fuelling: 40-60 g carbs/h from the first 30 min, 1-2 bottles with electrolytes.
If the missed days were due to illness, or Thursday was skipped, keep it to 90 min.

days.session: Indoor Z2 endurance ride + Workout B (afternoon)
days.details:
Ride (morning, indoor trainer/Zwift because of heavy drizzle):
120 min | Aerobic endurance, replaces the outdoor long ride | Z2, RPE 3-4
Steady Z2 throughout with no structured intervals. Cadence 85-95 rpm, and alternate 10 min seated with 1-2 min standing to stay comfortable. Last 10 min Z1-2.
Use a strong fan. It's warm (up to 27 0C), so drink 750 ml+ fluid/h with electrolytes.
Fuelling: 60-80 g carbs/h from the first 20 min.

Afternoon (4+ h after the ride, after a proper meal):
Workout B:
Warm-up: 5 min bike or row, walking lunges, hip airplanes, 2 ramp-up sets on split squat
Bulgarian Split Squat 3x6/leg (3 RIR)
Hip Thrust 3x8 (2-3 RIR)
Single-arm Dumbbell Row 3x8/side
Half-kneeling Overhead Press 3x8/side
Dead Bug 3x10/side
Copenhagen Plank 3x20s/side
Rest: 2-3 min between split squat and hip thrust sets, 60-90 s for the rest
Objective: Build single-leg strength and hip stability for seated power and MTB handling, 72 h clear of Tuesday's committed double.
days.fallback: If signals are poor (RHR 5+ bpm above average with low HRV or poor sleep): ride 75-90 min, all Z1-2. Do Workout B as 2 sets with the upper-body and trunk work only, or skip it.

days.details: 45 min gentle flow: hips, hamstrings, thoracic rotation and breathing. Wetter day, so stay indoors. An easy 30-45 min walk is fine as an alternative or add-on.
